en: How did Christianity become the world's leading religion?
Once an epidemic killed a tenth of Rome,

text:
그런 *페스트* 같은 어떤
전염병이 돈 적이 있습니다

en: But the Christians had a faith that didn't fear death,
So when someone caught the disease,

text:
다른 사람들은 건드리면
내가 *전염*될까 봐 다 놔뒀는데
en: Everyone else left them, afraid of catching it.

text:
그래서 기독교인들이 그걸 다
그 동네에서는
en: So in their towns the Christians
cleared the bodies and cared for people.

text:
그러니까 훨씬 더
*위생*적이 됐죠 시체가 없으니까
en: It got much cleaner, with no bodies lying around.

text:
그래서 다른 지역에서는
이 시체를 계속 놔두니까

en: and many were healed and recovered.
toward the world and other people.
